name: Check the balance of a specific member account
description:
Look up the member by member number and open their profile. The Accounts table has columns, in this exact left-to-right order: Acct No, Product, Balance, Opened, Status, History. A member can have several accounts. Find the ONE row whose Acct No column exactly matches the given account_no -- not the first row, not a guess. Once found, perform TWO SEPARATE reads against TWO DIFFERENT cells in that row: (1) read the Balance cell and output it as account_balance; (2) re-observe the page and read the Status cell (a different column than Balance) and output it as account_status. Do not read the same cell twice and do not confuse Balance with Status. If no row's Acct No matches account_no exactly, do not guess; call blocked.

Returns: account_balance — Balance of the account row whose Acct No matches account_no., account_status — Status (e.g. OPEN, HOLD, CLOSED) of the account row whose Acct No matches account_no.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found.
